articles.summary: As teams grow, institutional knowledge just doesn't get transmitted as easily. Whitney Sorenson, HubSpot's Chief Architect, shares HubSpot's Engineering Values — the values that have shaped the company that we are today — why they're valuable, and why it's crucial that we share them publicly and often.
articles.title: HubSpot’s Engineering Values
